title: John Harbaugh admits calling Amy Adams Strunk about Jeffery Simmons trade

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh admits calling Amy Adams Strunk about Jeffery Simmons trade
sources.description: Giants coach John Harbaugh apparently ruffled some feathers in Nashville by making a phone call to Titans owner Amy Adams Strunk in an effort to spark trade discussions for defensive tackle Jeffery Simmons.
